templates.description:
Skill templates for Angular 21 projects (zoneless, signals, Tailwind v4,
Vitest, Transloco i18n, OpenAPI-generated HTTP clients). Each skills/<slug>/
directory ships a body (template.md), common metadata (metadata.yml), and
per-provider frontmatter overrides (<provider>.yml). smith-template-install
composes the frontmatter at install time and names the destination skill
`smith-angular-<slug>` in the consumer project's provider-native skill dir.

Skill templates for Java 24 + Spring Boot 4 services. Today the set
ships a single `bootstrap` skill — interactive scaffold of a runnable
service (pom.xml, application entry, optional REST controller,
optional Liquibase changelog, application.yaml, .gitignore, README).
More skills (coding standards, tests + coverage, JPA + transactions,
OpenAPI contract, observability) can be added with /smith-template-add.
Each skills/<slug>/ directory ships a body (template.md), common
metadata (metadata.yml), and per-provider frontmatter overrides
(<provider>.yml). smith-template-install composes the frontmatter at
install time and names the destination skill
`smith-java-spring-boot-<slug>` in the consumer project's
provider-native skill dir.
